Technical terms in English with their Chinese equivalents. Lessons are taught in
English, and vocabulary is often harder than grammar, so use this page whenever
a word stops you.

**This glossary grows with the material.** It holds the programming terms that
Stage 1 needs, and the road-safety and statistics terms that Stages 1 and 2
use. Each later stage adds its own.

| English | 中文 | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| variable | [变量]{lang="zh-Hans"} | A name that refers to a value, such as `speed = 30`. |
| integer | [整数]{lang="zh-Hans"} | A whole number, such as 3 or -12. |
| float | [浮点数]{lang="zh-Hans"} | A number with a decimal point, such as 3.14. |
| string | [字符串]{lang="zh-Hans"} | Text in quotation marks, such as `"Leeds"`. |
| Boolean | [布尔值]{lang="zh-Hans"} | A value that is either `True` or `False`. |
| list | [列表]{lang="zh-Hans"} | An ordered collection of values that you can change. |
| dictionary | [字典]{lang="zh-Hans"} | A collection of values you look up by a key rather than by position. |
| index | [索引]{lang="zh-Hans"} | The position of an item in a list. Python starts counting at 0. |
| loop | [循环]{lang="zh-Hans"} | Code that repeats, once for each item or until a condition changes. |
| conditional | [条件语句]{lang="zh-Hans"} | An `if` statement: code that runs only when something is true. |
| function | [函数]{lang="zh-Hans"} | A named, reusable piece of code that takes inputs and gives back a result. |
| argument | [参数]{lang="zh-Hans"} | A value you pass into a function when you call it. |
| scope | [作用域]{lang="zh-Hans"} | The part of the program where a name can be used. |
| module | [模块]{lang="zh-Hans"} | A Python file whose code you can reuse in another file. |
| package | [包]{lang="zh-Hans"} | A folder of modules, such as `pandas`. |
| import | [导入]{lang="zh-Hans"} | To load a module or package so that your code can use it. |
| DataFrame | [数据框]{lang="zh-Hans"} | A table of data with named columns, from the `pandas` package. |
| missing value | [缺失值]{lang="zh-Hans"} | A cell with no data, shown as `NaN` in `pandas`. |
| traceback | [回溯信息]{lang="zh-Hans"} | The message Python prints when code fails, showing where it failed. |
| exception | [异常]{lang="zh-Hans"} | An error raised while the program runs, such as `ValueError`. |
| assertion | [断言]{lang="zh-Hans"} | An `assert` line that stops the program if something you expect is false. |
| debugger | [调试器]{lang="zh-Hans"} | A tool for running code one line at a time to see what it does. |
| test | [测试]{lang="zh-Hans"} | Code that checks that other code gives the right answer. |
| notebook | [笔记本]{lang="zh-Hans"} | A document that mixes text, code and the output of that code. |
| cell | [单元格]{lang="zh-Hans"} | One block of text or code in a notebook. |
| repository | [仓库]{lang="zh-Hans"} | A project folder whose history is tracked by Git. |
| commit | [提交]{lang="zh-Hans"} | A saved snapshot of your project in Git, with a message. |
| kernel | [内核]{lang="zh-Hans"} | The Python process that runs a notebook's code and remembers its variables. |
| parquet | Parquet [格式]{lang="zh-Hans"} | A file format for tables. It stores each column on its own, so it is small and quick to read. |
| slice | [切片]{lang="zh-Hans"} | A part of a table that you pick out, such as one city or one type of casualty. |
| aggregate | [汇总]{lang="zh-Hans"} | To add rows together into one number for each group, such as one total per year. |
| categorical | [分类变量]{lang="zh-Hans"} | A column whose values are labels rather than numbers, such as the day of the week. |
| collision | [碰撞事故]{lang="zh-Hans"} | A road crash that the police recorded. One row of the collision table is one collision. |
| casualty | [伤亡人员]{lang="zh-Hans"} | A person hurt or killed in a collision. One collision can have several casualties. |
| severity | [严重程度]{lang="zh-Hans"} | How bad an injury was. This data uses three levels: fatal, serious and slight. |
| KSI | [死亡或重伤]{lang="zh-Hans"} | Killed or seriously injured. It counts the fatal and the serious casualties together, and leaves the slight ones out. |
| exposure | [暴露量]{lang="zh-Hans"} | How much travel there was, such as the number of vehicles counted. You divide by it to turn a count into a rate. |
| denominator | [分母]{lang="zh-Hans"} | The number you divide by. A count of 20 means little until you know the denominator. |
| rate | [比率]{lang="zh-Hans"} | A count divided by exposure, such as collisions for every million vehicles counted. |
